# f5xc_certificate_chain (Resource)

Certificate chain is list of certificates used to establish chain of trust from server or client certificate to trusted CA root certificates.

To get more information about f5xc_certificate_chain, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/certificate-chain)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Certificate Chain - Basic

resource "f5xc_certificate_chain" "example" {
  name        = "example-certificate-chain"
  namespace   = "default"
  description = "Certificate chain example"

  certificate_url = "string:"
}
```
